claim: ignored-fallible-results gate is invoked from repository root and rejects invalid invocation
expected_evidence: report records repo-root invocation, exit 0 on clean/justified tree, and non-zero InvalidInvocation for wrong working directory if checked

claim: scan domain includes first-party production Rust under crates/*/src and xtask/src while excluding declared non-production domains
expected_evidence: report lists production scan roots and excluded non-production patterns with no production root skipped

claim: exceptions are deterministic, path-bound, narrow, justified, and reject malformed or overbroad records
expected_evidence: malformed or overbroad exception fixture exits non-zero with MalformedException or OverbroadException

claim: deterministic classifier assigns each production-like source match exactly one total outcome: Violation, JustifiedException, or NonProductionExcluded
expected_evidence: classifier fixtures record stable sorted outcomes for violation, justified exception, and non-production exclusion cases, with no duplicate or conflicting classification for any match

claim: exception validation rejects malformed syntax, missing owner, missing expiry or follow-up, overbroad path, overbroad class, and production-hiding non-production claims before any zero exit
expected_evidence: exception-validation fixtures exit non-zero with exact MalformedException or OverbroadException class for malformed, missing-owner, missing-expiry, overbroad-path, overbroad-class, and production-hiding non-production cases, and accept one narrow valid path-bound exception

claim: bare ignored Result or must-use expression statements in production-like Rust are rejected
expected_evidence: negative fixture for DISCARD-001 exits non-zero and reports ViolationFound with file and discard class

claim: let-underscore discard of fallible or must-use values is rejected by the gate and hard clippy deny
expected_evidence: lint-src evidence shows unused_must_use and clippy::let_underscore_must_use are denied; negative fixture or compile fixture demonstrates failure

claim: unused .ok() or .err() lossy conversion of fallible outcomes in production-like Rust is rejected
expected_evidence: negative fixture for DISCARD-003 exits non-zero and reports ViolationFound with file and discard class

claim: Err(_) => {} and Ok(()) | Err(_) => {} swallow patterns in production-like Rust are rejected unless justified
expected_evidence: negative fixture for DISCARD-004 exits non-zero and reports ViolationFound with file and discard class

claim: drop(<fallible>) explicit discard in production-like Rust is rejected or requires exact justified exception
expected_evidence: negative fixture for DISCARD-005 exits non-zero and reports ViolationFound with file and discard class

claim: silent-discard comments or allow markers without valid exception records are rejected
expected_evidence: fixture with undocumented allow marker exits non-zero with MalformedException or ViolationFound

claim: canonical Moon verification path executes ignored-fallible-results gate and fails when the gate fails
expected_evidence: verify-standard output or task graph evidence shows ignored-fallible-results gate ran and propagates non-zero exit

claim: source lint path hard-denies unused_must_use and clippy::let_underscore_must_use for production/source targets
expected_evidence: lint-src exits 0 on clean tree and command/policy evidence includes -D warnings plus effective unused_must_use and clippy::let_underscore_must_use denial

claim: gate report is deterministic across repeated runs on the same tree and exception set
expected_evidence: two consecutive runs report the same violation/exception set and same exit status

claim: missing script, malformed exception data, or unreadable production paths fail closed
expected_evidence: fail-closed fixtures or controlled invocations exit non-zero with MissingGateWiring, MalformedException, or UnreadableInput
